lines.cn: 太好了！我们来聊聊Is there a post office near here?。

grammarQuiz.q: 本单元语法重点：There be 句型。下列哪项与「post」词义最接近？
选择正确的英文：「办公室」

reading.passage: This unit is about Is there a post office near here?. In this lesson we learn words like post, office, post office, police, police station, hotel. Students practice reading and using these words in sentences about 附近有邮局吗.
reading.passageCn: 本单元主题是「附近有邮局吗」。我们学习 post, office, post office, police, police station, hotel 等词汇，并在句子中运用。

questions.q: What is this unit mainly about?
opts: Is there a post office near here?

questions.q: What does 「post」 mean in Chinese?

writing.prompt: Write 3–5 sentences about 「附近有邮局吗」 (Is there a post office near here?). Use at least 3 words from this unit.
writing.promptCn: 用 3–5 个句子描述「附近有邮局吗」，至少使用本单元 3 个词汇。

quizQuestions.q: 本单元「附近有邮局吗」的核心词是？
